# Giuseppe Di Guglielmo

Principal Engineer in the Intelligent Microelectronics Systems Division at
Fermilab. Adjunct Associate Professor of Electrical and Computer Engineering
at Northwestern University and Designated Academic Colleague in the
Department of Computer Science at Columbia University. IEEE Senior Member.

Specializes in system-level design and hardware acceleration for AI/ML, with
over 15 years of experience in high-level synthesis for ASIC and FPGA design.
Works with scientists to build intelligent detectors for harsh environments
with ultra-low-latency requirements, including radiation-resistant chips with
embedded ML for the Large Hadron Collider and ML algorithms for quantum
readout and control running in hardware at cryogenic temperatures. Part of
the Fermilab AI Program and of the Fermilab team contributing to the DOE
Genesis Mission, working on AI-accelerated co-design workflows for scientific
microelectronics and instrumentation.

Contact: gdg@fnal.gov
